subject: Startups
title: The Role of Mega Rounds
description: A quick, practical guide to The Role of Mega Rounds.

hook.text: In 2021, over 700 funding rounds exceeded $100 million. A decade earlier, rounds that size were front-page news.

buildup.text: Mega rounds accelerate growth. A $500M raise lets companies spend aggressively on hiring, expansion, and marketing.

discovery.text: But they also inflate valuations. A startup may raise $200M to justify a $2B valuation it hasn't earned yet.

twist.text: After 2022's downturn, mega rounds dried up.

climax.text: Klarna raised at $46B in 2021, then raised at $6. 7B in 2022.

punchline.text: Raising too much at a high price is its own trap.

quiz.question: What happened to Klarna's valuation between 2021 and 2022?
